# Cutroom tools

<!-- Generated by `cutroom docs` from the CLI's own help text. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command accepts `--help`. Commands with `--json` print one JSON object on stdout;
errors print a suggested fix and exit non-zero. Commands that act on a job append to
`jobs/<id>/log.md` and `jobs/<id>/logs/commands.jsonl`.

## Tool plugins

Commands provided by modules in `src/cutroom/tools/` (see `registry.py`).

| command | group | what it does | writes a new timeline version | tests |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `analyze` | analysis | Run all perception on a job and write analysis/summary.md. | no | `tests/test_analysis.py` |
| `frames` | analysis | Labelled frame grid at chosen times: visual evidence on demand. | no | `tests/test_analysis.py` |
| `topics` | analysis | Prepare or check the topic-map task (agent-in-the-loop). | no | `tests/test_analysis.py` |
| `audio` | audio | Plan the voice chain and loudness target from the audio analysis. | yes | `tests/test_audio.py` |
| `loudness` | audio | Measure integrated loudness, LRA and true peak of a file. | no | `tests/test_audio.py` |
| `cut` | cutting | Remove a range or whole sentences by hand, refusing mid-word cuts. | yes | `tests/test_cutting.py` |
| `detect-retakes` | cutting | Find stumbles, false starts and repeated sentences; optionally cut them. | yes | `tests/test_cutting.py` |
| `move` | cutting | Reorder: move sentences (or a source range) to another point in the edit. | yes | `tests/test_cutting.py` |
| `remove-fillers` | cutting | Remove um/uh (and optionally discourse markers) with natural joins. | yes | `tests/test_cutting.py` |
| `remove-silence` | cutting | Shorten long pauses and trim head/tail, keeping natural rhythm. | yes | `tests/test_cutting.py` |
| `restore` | cutting | Put a previously cut range back (by cut id). | yes | `tests/test_cutting.py` |
| `rough-cut` | cutting | Standard first pass: assemble → silence → fillers → retakes → preview. | yes | `tests/test_cutting.py`, `tests/test_render.py` |
| `captions` | graphics | Plan captions (phrases, timing, emphasis, placement) in a caption style. | yes | `tests/test_captions.py` |
| `export-captions` | graphics | Write .srt and .vtt caption files for a timeline version. | no | `tests/test_captions.py` |
| `graphic-add` | graphics | Add a motion graphic from a template, fact-checked and placed off faces. | yes | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `graphic-list` | graphics | List the graphics in a timeline version with timing, placement and sources. | no | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `graphic-move` | graphics | Retime or re-place a graphic (keeps its parameters and sources). | yes | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `graphic-remove` | graphics | Remove a graphic by id. | yes | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `punch-in` | graphics | Disguise jump cuts with alternating punch-ins (or set one clip's zoom). | yes | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `template-preview` | graphics | Render still previews of graphics templates to look at before using them. | no | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `templates` | graphics | List motion-graphics templates, their variants and parameters. | no | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `transition` | graphics | Put an overlay transition (dip, flash, whip, swipe, glitch) on a cut. | yes | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `render` | render | Render a timeline version (fast preview or full-quality final). | no | `tests/test_render.py` |
| `assemble` | timeline | Create the first timeline: every main source, whole, in order. | yes | `tests/test_timeline.py` |
| `checkout` | timeline | Set HEAD to any version (later edits branch from it). | no | `tests/test_timeline.py` |
| `diff` | timeline | Human-readable change summary between two timeline versions. | no | `tests/test_timeline.py` |
| `show` | timeline | Print a timeline as an outline, cut list, summary or JSON. | no | `tests/test_timeline.py` |
| `snapshot` | timeline | Save the current version again as a named checkpoint. | yes | `tests/test_timeline.py` |
| `style` | timeline | Switch the style or client theme of an edit (graphics and captions restyle on render). | yes | `tests/test_graphics.py` |
| `undo` | timeline | Move HEAD back to the parent version (nothing is deleted). | no | `tests/test_timeline.py` |
| `validate` | timeline | Validate a timeline (schema, structure, word-boundary cuts). | no | `tests/test_timeline.py` |
| `versions` | timeline | List timeline versions with their changelog lines. | no | `tests/test_timeline.py` |
| `ffmpeg` | utility | Run any FFmpeg command in the job folder (logged; sources protected). | no | `tests/test_tools.py` |

## `cutroom analyze`

Everything the agent needs to "see and hear" the footage: proxy and audio, transcript,
refined words (fillers, untranscribed sounds), audio report (loudness, noise, clipping,
silences), visual report (shots, faces, framing, exposure, blur, contact sheets), pacing map,
footage-type guess, and a topic-map task. Each step is cached; re-running is cheap.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--source`, `-s`: Source id(s), e.g. S01. Default: all.
- `--visual`, `--no-visual`: Include shot/face/exposure analysis.
- `--force`, `--no-force`: Recompute even if results exist.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom assemble`

Create a timeline from the job's main sources (nothing removed yet). Saves a new version.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--source`, `-s`: Source id(s), e.g. S01. Default: all.
- `--style`: Style name (styles/<name>.style.yaml). (default: default)
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom audio`

Decide the voice chain (high-pass, denoise only if needed, gentle EQ, compression set
from the measured speech level, de-essing) and the loudness target, with a reason for each
stage. Renders then apply it and verify loudness and true peak on the output file.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--target-lufs`: Integrated loudness target (default from style: -14).
- `--denoise`, `--no-denoise`: Force denoise on/off (default: decided from the noise measurement).
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom captions`

Plan captions from the refined word timings: phrases break at sentence ends, commas and
pauses (never after "the", "of", ...), at most 2 lines, reading speed checked, at most one
emphasised word, kept off faces and inside the platform safe zone, with an automatic scrim
when the background is too bright for contrast. Saves a new timeline version.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--style`: clean, bold-karaoke, word-highlight or minimal (default from style file).
- `--output`: Safe zone and line length to plan for. (default: youtube_long)
- `--burn-in`, `--files-only`: Draw captions into the video, or only export caption files.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom checkout`

Make a version current. The next edit creates a new version whose parent is this one.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `VERSION`: Version to make current, e.g. v002
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom cut`

Remove a range or whole sentences. With --sentences the cut covers exactly those sentences
and leaves a natural pause. With --from/--to, edges must fall between words (--snap fixes
them, --force overrides).

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--reason`: Why (recorded in the timeline and log).
- `--from`: Start of the range to remove (s).
- `--to`: End of the range to remove (s).
- `--sentences`: Sentence numbers as in analysis/topics.task.md, e.g. 3 or 2-3. Leaves a natural pause.
- `--source`: Source id: --from/--to are source times. Omit to use timeline times.
- `--snap`, `--no-snap`: Move edges that fall inside words to the nearest word boundary.
- `--force`, `--no-force`: Allow cutting inside a word (not recommended).
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--dry-run`: Show what would change without saving a new version.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom detect-retakes`

Find abandoned attempts the speaker redid: immediate repetitions ("we are, we are"), false
starts ("so the main — so the main thing is") and whole sentences said again. Keeps the last
complete take unless it is clearly worse. Writes analysis/retakes.json with reasons; --apply
cuts the confident ones (or --only the ids you choose).

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--apply`, `--no-apply`: Cut the candidates at or above --min-confidence.
- `--min-confidence`: Threshold for --apply. (default: 0.75)
- `--only`: Apply only these candidate ids (r001…).
- `--dry-run`: Show what would change without saving a new version.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom diff`

What changed between two versions: duration, clips, cuts added/restored, graphics, settings.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `A`: Older version, e.g. v003
- `B` (optional): Newer version (default HEAD)
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom docs`

Regenerate docs/TOOLS.md, docs/TIMELINE_SCHEMA.md and docs/timeline.schema.json from the code.

Parameters:

- `--check`, `--no-check`: Exit 1 if the generated docs are out of date instead of writing them.

## `cutroom doctor`

Check the whole toolchain on this machine and write config/machine.json.

Detects OS, CPU, RAM, GPU and FFmpeg capabilities, tests hardware encoders,
then ingests, proxies and transcribes a bundled clip and checks the words and
timings against its known script. Exit code 0 means everything works.

Parameters:

- `--quick`, `--no-quick`: Skip the end-to-end ingest/proxy/transcribe smoke test.
- `--select-asr`: Benchmark speech models on this machine and pick the best that fits.
- `--asr-model`: Force a speech model (see `cutroom models list`).
- `--download`, `--no-download`: Download the chosen speech model if missing.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom export-captions`

Export the planned captions as SubRip (.srt) and WebVTT (.vtt), in edit time, ready to
upload to YouTube. Always deliver these, even when captions are burned in.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom ffmpeg`

Passthrough for anything no tool covers yet. Runs in the job folder; relative paths are
job-relative. Refuses to write outside the job or over any source file. The full command is
logged so it can be turned into a proper tool later (the self-extension rule).

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `ARGS...`: FFmpeg arguments after `--`, e.g. -- -i source/S01.mp4 -t 5 renders/x.mp4
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom frames`

Grab frames at specific times and tile them, each labelled with its time, into one image
to open and look at (e.g. around a cut, a graphic entrance, or a suspected glitch).

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--at`: Times in seconds (repeat or pass several).
- `--source`: Source id: times are source times. Omit for timeline (HEAD) times.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version for timeline times.
- `--grid`: Columns x rows, e.g. 3x3 (rows grow if needed). (default: 3x3)
- `--out`: Output JPEG (default review/frames/...).
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom graphic-add`

Add a graphic. Numbers it shows must be found in its --fact references (transcript span or a
document in the job), or it is refused. It is placed inside the safe area, above the caption
band, on the side that covers the least of the face, holds at least the reading time, and
is attached to the moment it appears, so later cuts move it with its content.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `TEMPLATE`: Template id (see `cutroom templates`).
- `--at`: Timeline time it appears (s or m:ss).
- `--sentence`: Appear when this sentence starts (numbering as in topics.task.md).
- `--duration`: Seconds on screen (default: template default, at least the reading time).
- `--variant`: Template variant.
- `--param`, `-p`: key=value (repeat). Lists: a|b|c. Data: 2019:12,2020:30.
- `--fact`, `-f`: Source of what it shows: sentences:12, S01@83.2-90.5, t:1:23-1:30, brief, doc:inputs/x.md (repeat).
- `--anchor`: Force an anchor (e.g. bottom-right); default chooses off the face.
- `--reason`: Why this graphic helps the viewer. (default: )
- `--force`, `--no-force`: Allow more than the simultaneous-graphics limit.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom graphic-list`

Every graphic: id, template/variant, what it shows, when, where, and its fact references.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom graphic-move`

Move a graphic in time or on screen. Facts are re-checked against its stored references and
placement is recomputed (off the face, above the captions, away from other graphics).

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `GRAPHIC_ID`: Graphic id, e.g. g0003.
- `--at`: New start (timeline s or m:ss).
- `--duration`: New length (s).
- `--anchor`: Force an anchor.
- `--replace`: Choose a different anchor than now (after a face or safe-area failure).
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom graphic-remove`

Remove one graphic (the earlier version keeps it; `cutroom undo` brings it back).

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `GRAPHIC_ID`: Graphic id, e.g. g0003.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom ingest`

Probe, hash and register footage in a job. Originals are never modified.

By default files are copied into jobs/<id>/source/ (read-only) so the job is
self-contained. Identical files (same hash) are detected and skipped.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `PATHS...` (optional): Files or folders. Default: files already in jobs/<id>/source/.
- `--reference`: Read files in place instead of copying them into the job (saves disk; breaks if files move).
- `--role`: Role for these files: main, broll, music, sfx, voiceover, image.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom jobs`

List jobs.

Parameters:

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom loudness`

EBU R128 measurement (FFmpeg ebur128): integrated LUFS, loudness range, true peak.

Parameters:

- `PATH`: Media file (a render, a source...).
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom machine`

Show the machine profile (hardware, chosen models, encoders, concurrency).

Parameters:

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom models list`

List available speech models, their size, licence and download state.

Parameters:

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom models pull`

Download a speech model (pinned revision) into models/asr/.

Parameters:

- `NAME`: Model name, e.g. small.en
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom move`

Move material to another position, e.g. a strong line to the very start as a cold open.
With --sentences the block is lifted at the middle of the surrounding pauses, so both the
gap it leaves and the moved block keep natural rhythm. Nothing is deleted.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--reason`: Why (e.g. 'cold open hook').
- `--to`: Timeline time to insert at (snapped to the nearest clip boundary); 0 = start.
- `--sentences`: Sentence numbers to move, e.g. 8-9.
- `--from`: Source start (with --until).
- `--until`: Source end (with --from).
- `--source`: Source id (default: the only source).
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom new`

Create a job workspace: jobs/<job-id>/ with brief.md, log.md and stage folders.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: New job id, e.g. acme-launch-video
- `--client`: Client name (selects styles/clients/<client>.style.yaml later).
- `--title`: Working title.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom probe`

Inspect a media file (streams, fps, VFR, HDR, rotation, duration) without ingesting it.

Parameters:

- `PATH`: Media file to inspect.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom proxy`

Make constant-frame-rate proxies and extract audio (16 kHz WAV for ASR, 48 kHz FLAC for analysis).

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--source`, `-s`: Source id(s), e.g. S01. Default: all.
- `--short-side`: Proxy short side in pixels (default from machine profile, 540).
- `--force`, `--no-force`: Rebuild even if up to date.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom punch-in`

A jump cut on the same camera angle looks like a glitch; alternating the framing (100 % ↔
112 %) at those cuts reads as a deliberate camera change. Joins that already fall on a camera
change are left alone. The crop is centred on the face, keeping the head inside the frame.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--auto`: Alternate framing at every same-angle jump cut.
- `--clip`: One clip id to reframe.
- `--scale`: Zoom factor (default style graphics.rules.punch_in_scale).
- `--push-to`: With --clip: slow push from --scale to this zoom over the clip.
- `--clear`, `--no-clear`: Remove all reframes.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom remove-fillers`

Remove filler words. Pure hesitations (um, uh, er, hmm) always; discourse markers only when
isolated by punctuation and enabled; meaningful uses ("I like it", "you know him") are
protected because they are not set off by commas. Leaves a natural pause at each join.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--contextual`, `--no-contextual`: Also remove discourse markers ('you know', 'I mean', 'like') when set off by commas. Default from style.
- `--acoustic`, `--no-acoustic`: Also remove untranscribed voiced sounds in pauses (likely 'um'). Default from style.
- `--dry-run`: Show what would change without saving a new version.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom remove-silence`

Shorten every pause longer than the style's max_pause to a natural length (longer after a
sentence end; possible dramatic pauses kept longer), and trim silence before the first and
after the last word. Cuts always sit inside pauses, never inside words.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--max-pause`: Pauses longer than this are shortened (s). Default from style.
- `--keep`: Pause length to keep mid-sentence (s). Default from style.
- `--dry-run`: Show what would change without saving a new version.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom render`

Render a version. Every audio join gets a short fade (no clicks); afterwards the render is
checked: duration and frame count match the timeline, and every join is scanned for clicks.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--mode`: preview: 540p from proxies with burned-in timecode; final: full resolution from sources. (default: preview)
- `--captions`, `--no-captions`: Burn in the timeline's captions (if any).
- `--audio-chain`, `--raw-audio`: Apply the timeline's voice chain and loudness (if any).
- `--range`: Render only timeline seconds START-END, e.g. 30-55 (for reviewing a section).
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom restore`

Undo specific cuts without undoing whole versions, e.g. a filler that was really a word.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `CUT_IDS...`: Cut ids, e.g. x0012 (see `show --format cuts`).
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom rough-cut`

Run the standard rough cut. Each step saves its own version, so any step can be inspected
(`cutroom diff`), undone or adjusted. Prints the resulting outline path and render checks.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--source`, `-s`: Source id(s), e.g. S01. Default: all.
- `--style`: Style name (default: the timeline's or 'default').
- `--retake-confidence`: Apply retake candidates at or above this confidence. (default: 0.75)
- `--fresh`, `--no-fresh`: Start from a new assembly even if a timeline exists.
- `--render`, `--no-render`: Render a preview at the end.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom show`

Show a timeline version. The outline lists every clip with its timeline and source times and
the words spoken, and between clips every cut with its reason: the main way to read an edit.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--format`: View to print. (default: outline)
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom snapshot`

Checkpoint HEAD as a new version with a message (e.g. 'sent to client for review').

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--message`, `-m`: What this checkpoint is.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom status`

Show a job's sources, derived files and stage status.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom style`

Every graphic and caption takes its colours, fonts, sizes and motion from the style's
design tokens, so switching the theme restyles the whole edit without touching it.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--name`: Style (styles/<name>.style.yaml).
- `--client-style`: Client theme (styles/clients/<name>.style.yaml); 'none' to clear.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom template-preview`

Draw each template variant at mid-hold with the theme of a style (and client), so the look
can be checked by eye before graphics go into an edit.

Parameters:

- `TEMPLATE` (optional): Template id (default: all).
- `--variant`: One variant (default: all).
- `--param`, `-p`: key=value (default: demo values).
- `--style`: Style file name. (default: default)
- `--client`: Client style (styles/clients/<name>.style.yaml).
- `--background`: Image to draw over (e.g. a frame of the footage).
- `--out`: Folder for the PNGs. (default: template_previews)
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom templates`

Every template the agent can add with `graphic-add`, with variants, parameters (* = required),
which parameters are facts that must be sourced, and where it sits on screen.

Parameters:

- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom topics`

Topic segmentation needs judgement, so the agent does it: this writes the task file with
numbered sentences and the schema; the agent writes analysis/topics.json; --check validates
that every sentence is covered exactly once and the schema is right.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--check`: Validate analysis/topics.json instead of preparing the task.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom transcribe`

Transcribe sources locally with word-level timestamps.

Writes analysis/<source>/transcript.json (words, times, confidence),
transcript.txt (timestamped reading view; doubtful words marked) and
transcript.srt. Runs `proxy` audio extraction first if needed.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--source`, `-s`: Source id(s), e.g. S01. Default: all.
- `--model`: Override the speech model from the machine profile.
- `--hotword`: Names/terms to bias recognition toward (repeatable).
- `--verbatim`, `--no-verbatim`: Keep fillers, stumbles and repetitions (needed for cutting them).
- `--force`, `--no-force`: Re-transcribe even if a transcript exists.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom transition`

Most cuts should stay plain cuts; use a transition to mark a topic change or a jump in time.
It is drawn over the cut and moves with it if the edit changes.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--at`: Timeline time; the nearest cut is used.
- `--join`: Cut number (1 = between the first and second clip).
- `--variant`: dip, flash, whip, swipe or glitch. (default: dip)
- `--duration`: Seconds, centred on the cut.
- `--reason`: Why (topic change, time jump…). (default: )
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom undo`

Undo the last edit: HEAD moves to the parent version. The undone version stays on disk.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom validate`

Check a timeline: schema, overlaps, source ranges, and that no cut lands inside a word.
Warnings (graphics whose moment was cut, unsourced numbers) are listed but do not fail.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--version`, `-v`: Timeline version (v003, 3, HEAD, HEAD~1). Default: HEAD.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.

## `cutroom version`

Print the Cutroom version.

## `cutroom versions`

List every timeline version, its parent, duration and what produced it. * marks HEAD.

Parameters:

- `JOB_ID`: Job id (folder name under jobs/) or path to a job folder.
- `--json`: Print machine-readable JSON on stdout.
